rules.instruction: Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
rules.situation: the description states that an item is tested or assessed to evaluate one or more properties

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly lists multiple objectives or criteria that an activity is meant to address: Preserve the stated objectives or criteria in the BPMN task label rather than narrowing the label to only one of them.
rules.situation: the description explicitly lists multiple objectives or criteria that an activity is meant to address

rules.instruction: When the description states that a process can end with one of several mutually exclusive outcomes: Model the choice with an exclusive gateway and connect each outgoing branch to the activity or end event corresponding to that outcome.
rules.situation: the description states that a process can end with one of several mutually exclusive outcomes

rules.instruction: When When a description names multiple distinct activities within one phase and states that the process continues only after every activity is finished,: model the activities as parallel branches with a parallel split and join, rather than as a sequence.
rules.situation: the description names multiple distinct evaluations that must all be completed before a shared next step
